mechanism: Both drugs inhibit cardiac potassium channels and have Class IA antiarrhythmic properties, increasing risk of QT prolongation, torsades de pointes, and additive cardiac effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; monitor ECG closely, check QTc interval baseline and during treatment, maintain electrolyte levels (K+, Mg2+), and consider alternative antipsychotic with lower cardiac risk.
